name: Health Goth
summary: Black, white and silver, 3D-rendered blades and mesh forms, sportswear and gym signs, with a cold, clean look. It grew from a 2013 online group that mixed goth, sport and net art.

philosophy.core_thesis: Treat the body and the interface as one clean, dark machine: goth mood, gym function, no decoration that has no use.
design_principles: Set the ground at #0A0A0C and use white (#F4F4F5) as the main ink.
Render one 3D form (a blade, a mesh or a chrome ring) at 40% to 60% of the frame, with no people.
Use thin sans type in capitals at +0.2em, in 1 weight (300) for display.
Add one acid-silver accent (#C9D1D9) on no more than 8% of the surface.
Set strict 8px modules and align text on a 12-column grid with 24px gutters.
Add sport labels: a size code, a small cross or a rep count at 11px to 12px.
Keep the radius at 0px on panels and at 2px on buttons.

layout.grid_mechanics: A strict 12-column grid with 24px gutters and an 8px baseline; one object sits in the centre columns.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 40% to 55% of the surface stays empty; the spacing scale is 8, 16, 32 and 64px.
layout.alignment_rules: Flush-left text blocks and a centred 3D object; labels align to the grid edge.
layout.container_geometry: Rectangles with a 0px radius and a 1px line; buttons with a 2px radius; thin rings for accents.

font_pairings.note: A wide technical display face with a neutral text face.
A wide capital face with a mono face for labels.
A condensed sans for a sport-label look.

typography.tracking: Display takes +0.2em; labels take +0.12em; body stays at 0.
hierarchy_rules: Use two weights: light (300) and bold (700).
Set all display text and labels in capitals.
Use one colour for ink and one for accent.

color.palette_structure: Black and white with one cold silver; no saturated hue.
color.contrast_rules: Text on void black holds at least 12:1; silver and ice carry lines and one accent, not long text.
color.surface_treatment: Flat black fields; 3D forms with a chrome or matte black skin; a 2% grain.
color.light_and_shadow: A single cold rim light on 3D forms; no coloured glow; no cast shadow on panels.

materiality.surface_simulation: Chrome, matte rubber and mesh fabric, rendered in 3D.
materiality.border_rules: A 1px line in graphite (#1C1D22) on panels; a 1px silver line on focus.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: No blur; elevation is a 1px line change, not a shadow.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Outline icons at 24px with a 1.5px line and square caps: crosses, arrows, a heart-rate line.
ornamentation_details.illustration: 3D renders of blades, mesh shells and rings, with tribal-style line patterns, and no people or clothes.

motion.transition_physics: The 3D form turns 360° in 16s; labels fade in over 300ms; panels slide by 8px.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover adds a 1px silver line and moves a label by 4px; the active state inverts black and white.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels cold, fit and focused, in a calm, controlled way.

use_cases: fitness and wellness brands with a dark tone
avoid_when: The brand needs a warm or friendly tone.
The audience expects colour and play.
The page carries long, dense reading text.

modifiers.how: Add an acid-green accent, HUD frames and data labels; keep the black ground.
Replace the black with a pale ground, add a soft blur and remove the labels.
Add chrome type, silver gradients and pixel icons.

pack.why: A sharp, grid-based enterprise icon set suits the cold, technical, sport-label look.

ground.why: Health goth sits on a black field with a fine grille, like a gym floor or a ventilation panel.
